companies.name: Linq
companies.desc: Programmable AI messaging platform that embeds AI agents inside text threads and phone calls — agents handle scheduling, task execution, and information retrieval directly within SMS and messaging apps
companies.investors: Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), TQ Ventures, Mucker Capital, Abstract, Anthos, Left Lane Capital
companies.hiring: Growth Analyst, Growth Associate, Growth Strategist (linqapp.com/s/careers)
companies.fit: a16z-led Series B at $1B valuation = aggressive GTM and growth analytics buildout; AI agents in messaging spans consumer and enterprise; Growth function hiring signals DA crossover opportunity

companies.name: Arva AI
companies.desc: AI agents that automate financial-crime compliance decisions for banks — KYC review, AML alert investigation, and fraud case management — using proprietary models trained on bank-specific data
companies.investors: Arthur Ventures (lead), Y Combinator, Gradient Ventures
companies.hiring: Head of Product, GTM Lead, BDR, AE-Banking, Head of Sales (YC jobs board)
companies.fit: YC + Arthur Ventures Series A with simultaneous PM and GTM hiring; regtech with live bank customers = internship pitch with compliance or fintech background has immediate credibility

companies.name: Dreamteam
companies.desc: AI-native CRM platform that replaces human SDR and AE tasks with pre-integrated AI teammates — handles prospecting, outreach, pipeline tracking, and follow-up for B2B sales teams
companies.investors: Together Fund (seed lead), Accel (Series A lead), Premji Invest
companies.fit: Accel-backed at $53M combined; AI-native CRM built by ex-Freshworks executives targeting Salesforce; cold GTM/PM pitch with CRM or sales-automation experience is well-timed at Series A

companies.name: LanceDB

companies.investors: Bessemer Venture Partners and Innovation Endeavors (co-led), Theory Ventures, Dimension, Swift Ventures, CRV, Y Combinator
companies.hiring: Product Manager (Teal, Nov 2026); Forward Deployed Engineer
companies.fit: BVP + Innovation Endeavors Series B with Microsoft AI as named customer; PM hire to bridge open-source developer community (12K+ GitHub stars) and enterprise sales motion

companies.name: Unsiloed AI

companies.fit: Felicis + YC seed at 7-person team = first GTM hire joining at day one; financial-document parsing is table-stakes for fintech AI pipelines; SDR hire signals outbound motion starting now

companies.name: Agentcard

companies.investors: Peak XV, Fin Capital, Y Combinator; angels Paul Graham, Adam D'Angelo, Tobi Lütke, Guillermo Rauch, Dharmesh Shah
